title: Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit
lede: Clément Delangue says Hugging Face will keep pushing for open-source AI after Jensen Huang left Nvidia, which agreed in September to buy the platform for $12.9 billion.

points: Delangue called Huang's exit a sad day and promised to fight for open-source AI harder than before.
The deal is Nvidia's second-largest acquisition and is still set to close in the first half of 2027.
The Justice Department has asked how the purchase would affect competition, Reuters reported in October.
Huang was a vocal backer of open-weight models, so his exit raises questions about Nvidia's stance under new leadership.
Hugging Face did not answer whether it has spoken with interim CEO Colette Kress.

sections.text: Nvidia is set to own one of the main places developers get open models; without Huang, it is less certain how the company will treat open weights once it does.
